thesis: Standard Chartered initiated UNI coverage with a $6.5 end-2026 / $100 end-2030 path, layered on top of the UNIfication fee-switch live since Jan 1 2026 (134k UNI burned on June 5 alone). +34.6% 7d on vol/mcap 0.48 — real bid, not stale rotation, and outperforming both BTC (+5.5% 7d) and ETH (+7.4% 7d). Wrong if it loses the $2.85 base — that would give back the entire Standard Chartered move and signal the deflationary thesis hasn't outrun post-BOJ alt-derisk.
